sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and face an Alsager side sitting bottom with just 4 points from 10 games. This should be a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to extend their commanding position at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could prove pivotal for maintaining pressure on Sandbach; Stafford's recent form shows a draw in their latest outing but remain just two points back. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in an intriguing clash between two of the division's stronger sides, with both teams capable of pushing the title race. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a local derby that sees the former (4th, 19 points) coming off a win against a side struggling in 9th place. In-form Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir as they continue their solid campaign. Barnton host Shawbury United after a recent win, facing a side in severe form trouble at 15th. New Mills, sitting 8th, make the trip to Market Drayton Town, both chasing mid-table security. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath at home, with both teams in the lower half seeking positive results. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom with just 7 points, travel to Telford Town—the league's lowest-ranked team on 2 points—in a clash between two struggling sides. Finally, Widnes Town visit Brereton Social; Widnes are anchored at the bottom with just 2 points and will look to upset a mid-table opponent.
